workItem: P8.29 First Product Surface Decision Boundary Plan

candidateSurfaces.label: Static local workbench export
candidateSurfaces.reason: Closest to proven P8.21-P8.24 evidence, browser-inspectable, local-file only, no install or remote permissions required.

candidateSurfaces.label: CLI report commands
candidateSurfaces.reason: Useful and small, but creates an executable command contract and distribution surface.

candidateSurfaces.label: Local app
candidateSurfaces.reason: Requires app shell, persistence, navigation, and richer UI product boundaries.

candidateSurfaces.label: Editor integration
candidateSurfaces.reason: Requires editor permissions, install/update semantics, and stronger source-write boundaries.

candidateSurfaces.label: GitHub workflow integration
candidateSurfaces.reason: Requires remote execution, repository permissions, checks, secrets, and branch policy boundaries.

candidateSurfaces.label: Team workflow automation
candidateSurfaces.reason: Requires multi-user authority, RBAC, audit, notification, and lifecycle governance.
